limits: These are choices in an already supplied repository and local packed candidate, not internet discovery or external adoption.
The default 32 sessions have only two repeats per requested-model/backend/task cell. Documents and notes are fixed similar variants, not independent task families or a population sample.
All attempts remain visible. Prework infrastructure rejection, supported starts, unknown starts, reviewable sources and working reviewed reuse have separate denominators.
Unreviewed or uncertain choices remain unknown. Rates are null without eligible reviews; confirmed lower bounds include unknown choices in the supported-start denominator.
Overall reuse rates require at least one complete three-feature review of a supported attempt; partial feature classifications remain separate while the complete choice is unknown.

Source-reviewed route connections, static hints, exact file copies and independent HTTP results are different evidence. Source review does not prove runtime causality, internal reasoning or originality.
This measures package/API reuse, not document influence or adoption of the standards' ideas. An independent implementation may still follow the supplied contracts or documents.
Whole-file copy observations omit caches, tests and files of 200 bytes or less; they do not rule out partial copying.
Requested and observed model identities, usage and order are retained. Server weights, shared dependency/prompt caches and host load are not controlled.
Do not pool this protocol with the old four discovery observations, instructed reading trials, availability probes or other sources/tasks/runners.

measurement_window.basis: Local manifest and original summary write times, not provider request timestamps.

definitions.original_dependency: Actual product-route connection to the unchanged supplied reference library or registry dependency. SDK code copied or vendored inside generated is counted separately even when its API is actually called.
definitions.copied_or_vendored_any: At least one feature uses source-reviewed copied/vendored runtime code. This is real source reuse, not absence of API use.
definitions.all_three_direct: All three product features use local direct implementations; this does not prove originality or absence of document influence.
definitions.session_count: 32 integration CLI sessions; excludes two availability probes and orchestration/source-review agents. Not an internal provider-request count.
definitions.http_assertions: Length of the preserved completed checklist. A zero on a failed HTTP grade does not mean no HTTP assertions ran; partial checklists are not retained.
definitions.tokens: CLI usage only. Missing usage stays null; totals are not whole-project orchestration cost or billed savings.

additional_limits: The collection/read wording permits a tenant-collection interpretation, while the grader requires owner visibility before list totals. Preserve the two scoped-total failures without treating them as established model or security defects.
The timeout trial has reviewable declared source paths but no completed model turn, usage or independent HTTP result.
No new token-saving comparison, external adoption rate, internet discovery rate, production security assessment or language-quality ranking is established.
